title: MuSc: Zero-Shot Industrial Anomaly Classification and Segmentation with Mutual Scoring of the Unlabeled Images
mechanism: Training-free zero-shot segmentation: each patch is scored by its distance to patches of the other unlabelled test images, since normal patches recur and anomalies are rare.
adaptation: Transductive per E1 module and layout group (and per source in test): score each cell against the other cells of the same module; use the map to raise crack/inactive logits in components where house p < 0.001; scuff repeated across a module partly self-cancels.
min_experiment: Offline: MuSc maps on F51/H36 and pool; recall of house-missed crack components (3 px dilation) and inactive at 1% false-alarm area; then fuse with PF ensemble. Kill if recall on missed components < 30% or fused relP@2 loss exceeds relR@2 gain.
evidence: R: zero-shot SOTA on MVTec AD / VisA at publication (abstract); no EL evidence.
prior_overlap: none; anomaly-detection priors never tried. Per-module thresholds and per-panel BN failed, but those are different mechanisms.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run per E1 module group and per source/layout; scuff streaks repeated across a module partly self-cancel; output used as crack/inactive recall prior fused with the PF ensemble.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same offline recall test as INP-Former on CV / F51 / H36 grouped by module; baseline PF ensemble; kill if < 30% of missed components recovered at 1% area or relP@2 loss exceeds relR@2 gain.
